info.title: ControlServer.ProtocolFaultProxy
info.description: A line-level relay in front of ControlServer's onboard NDJSON listener that can lose a chosen kind of DurableAck after the server has committed the message, and close that connection, so an L2 scenario can exercise the onboard's journal replay against the real server (8005-agv-control-server#30); or take the link down on request without dropping a chosen line, so a scenario can watch what each end does with the next session (8005-agv-control-server#31). Or lose one chosen server-to-onboard answer while the link stays up, so a scenario can watch the onboard retry against an authorization it never saw (8005-agv-onboard-hmi#39). Every other line is forwarded byte for byte. The relay itself is plain TCP on listenPort; this document covers the HTTP control plane. Loopback only.

get.summary: Liveness, the endpoint the relay actually listens on (the operating system's pick when listenPort is 0) and the forward target
Current drop plan plus the traffic log: connections (opened, closed, by whom), drops, and one record per line (connection, direction, envelope identity -- never a payload)

put.summary: Arm a plan: drop the next count DurableAcks whose payload.acceptedMessageType matches, closing the connection each time
Arm a plan: drop the next count server-to-onboard lines whose messageType matches, keeping the connection open. DurableAck is refused here; losing one takes the link down, which is drop-durable-ack

post.summary: Close every relay connection open right now at both ends without singling out a line to lose (lines already in flight go with the connection); the onboard reconnects on its own. Once per commandId: a retry reports the same connections and closes nothing. Moves no revision; the traffic log records closedBy = relay disconnected on request

200.description: Envelope whose body lists the connections closed

post.summary: Start a new round at revision 1 and disarm; the traffic log is kept

expectedRevision.description: Optional optimistic concurrency check, skipped on a replay.
